old_caption: A close-up view shows a bundle of uncooked spaghetti noodles partially submerged in vigorously boiling water. The water bubbles actively, with foam visible on the surface. The noodles remain mostly stationary, fanned out near the edge of the pot, while the boiling water churns around them. The camera maintains a steady position, focused on the interaction between the noodles and the boiling water. The lighting highlights the yellow color of the pasta against the turbulent, foamy water. No other objects or characters are visible in the frame.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a pot of boiling water, where a bundle of uncooked spaghetti noodles is being added. The water is vigorously bubbling, indicating it is at a high temperature. As the spaghetti is dropped into the pot, it begins to sink and spread out slightly due to the buoyancy and movement of the water. The camera remains steady throughout, focusing on the interaction between the noodles and the boiling water. The lighting is bright, highlighting the golden hue of the uncooked pasta against the clear, bubbling water. There are no other objects or characters visible in the frame, keeping the viewer's attention solely on the cooking process. The video emphasizes the texture and movement of the noodles as they begin to cook, providing a detailed look at the initial stages of preparing a pasta dish.
caption: The video captures a close-up of a pot of vigorously boiling water into which a fan-shaped bundle of dry, rigid yellow spaghetti strands is leaned against the left side. The cut tips rest at the left edge above the waterline while the strands angle rightward and downward into the churning liquid. The water boils continuously, with bubbles rising, bursting, and reforming, and white foam patches shifting shape and position. The pasta bundle keeps a roughly constant orientation relative to the pot, showing no clear bending, sinking, or stirring. The submerged portions stay in contact with the boiling water throughout, while the dry portions at the left edge remain rigid and unchanged in color. A sliver of the metal pot rim and a pale surface show at the lower-left edge, and the camera drifts slightly, revealing more of this margin as the view shifts. The right side of the view stays filled with turbulent, bubbling water and foam.
